verdict.rationale: Issuing a branded stablecoin is a fair question for a crypto and stablecoin platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence covers only accepting stablecoin payments, holding USDC balances, USDC payouts, stablecoin-backed cards and a fiat-to-crypto onramp. Nothing documents an issuance product with minting, redemption, reserve management or its access gating.
